title.zh: EVE 学院：市场交易入门

blocks.en: EVE Online's massive player driven markets are the lifeblood of New Eden.
blocks.zh: EVE Online 庞大的玩家驱动市场是新伊甸的命脉。

blocks.en: Learning how to navigate the market,
blocks.zh: 学会如何使用市场、

blocks.en: buy the things you need for a fair price,
blocks.zh: 以公道的价格买到所需物品、

blocks.en: and sell the goods you build or gather,
blocks.zh: 卖出你制造或采集的货物，

blocks.en: will give you the foundation to build a successful career in this vast universe.
blocks.zh: 会为你在这个广阔宇宙中成就一番事业打下基础。

blocks.en: When it comes to the markets in EVE, location is key.
blocks.zh: 说到 EVE 的市场，位置是关键。

blocks.en: You can only see items listed for sale in your current region
blocks.zh: 你只能看到当前星域内挂单出售的物品，

blocks.en: and if you buy an item from a particular station,
blocks.zh: 而且如果你在某个空间站买了东西，

blocks.en: you must go to that station to pick up your purchase.
blocks.zh: 必须亲自去那个空间站提货。

blocks.en: For example, if you list a ship for sale in the system of Jita,
blocks.zh: 例如，如果你在吉他（Jita）星系挂单出售一艘船，

blocks.en: it cannot then be purchased by someone in Amarr,
blocks.zh: 艾玛（Amarr）的玩家就无法购买，

blocks.en: as these two systems are in different regions.
blocks.zh: 因为这两个星系位于不同的星域。

blocks.en: They would need to go to the appropriate region to purchase it,
blocks.zh: 他们需要去对应的星域购买，

blocks.en: and then pick it up from the specific station in which the item was being sold.
blocks.zh: 然后到出售该物品的那个空间站提货。

blocks.en: Because of this distributed nature of EVE Markets,
blocks.zh: 由于 EVE 市场的这种分散特性，

blocks.en: prices for an item may be very different depending on where you go to sell it.
blocks.zh: 同一件物品的价格可能因出售地点不同而相差很大。

blocks.en: Trade hubs have naturally emerged
blocks.zh: 于是自然形成了一些贸易中心，

blocks.en: where many buy and sell orders are listed by players.
blocks.zh: 玩家在那里挂出大量买单和卖单。

blocks.en: Due to the high volume of trade at these trade hubs,
blocks.zh: 由于贸易中心交易量很大，

blocks.en: they are a good place to go if you are trying to find a specific item,
blocks.zh: 如果你想找某件特定物品，

blocks.en: or just to ensure you're getting a fair price.
blocks.zh: 或者只是想确保买得公道，那里都是好去处。

blocks.en: The largest trade hub is in the system of Jita,
blocks.zh: 最大的贸易中心位于吉他星系，

blocks.en: the Caldari Navy Assembly Plant located at Planet 4 Moon 4.
blocks.zh: 即 4 号行星 4 号卫星的加达里海军组装厂（Caldari Navy Assembly Plant）。

blocks.en: Each of the four empires have trade hubs in their space,
blocks.zh: 四大帝国在各自的领地都有贸易中心，

blocks.en: so you can always find one nearby,
blocks.zh: 所以想去购物的话，

blocks.en: if you're looking to make a shopping trip.
blocks.zh: 附近总能找到一个。

blocks.en: You can open the market by clicking on the Regional Market icon
blocks.zh: 点击屏幕左侧 Neocom 面板中的星域市场（Regional Market）图标

blocks.en: in the Neocom panel on the left hand side of your screen.
blocks.zh: 即可打开市场。

blocks.en: This will open the regional market window,
blocks.zh: 这会打开星域市场窗口，

blocks.en: where you can view all items that are currently for sale
blocks.zh: 你可以在这里查看当前所在星域中

blocks.en: in the region of space you are in.
blocks.zh: 所有正在出售的物品。

blocks.en: By using the drop down menus or the search bar on the left side of the market screen
blocks.zh: 使用市场界面左侧的下拉菜单或搜索栏，

blocks.en: you can find items listed on the market,
blocks.zh: 就能找到市场上挂单的物品，

blocks.en: which you can then view in the panel on the right.
blocks.zh: 并在右侧面板中查看。

blocks.en: Whenever you buy or sell an item on the market,
blocks.zh: 每次在市场上买卖物品，

blocks.en: you are interacting with another player.
blocks.zh: 你都是在和另一位玩家打交道。

blocks.en: Players create buy and sell orders for items
blocks.zh: 玩家为物品创建买单和卖单，

blocks.en: which form the foundation for the living market.
blocks.zh: 构成了这个鲜活市场的基础。

blocks.en: To see the list of buy and sell orders for an item,
blocks.zh: 要查看某件物品的买单和卖单列表，

blocks.en: click the 'View Details' button.
blocks.zh: 点击「查看详情（View Details）」按钮。

blocks.en: This will pull up the details screen,
blocks.zh: 这会打开详情界面，

blocks.en: where you can see all the orders which are currently available for that item.
blocks.zh: 显示该物品当前所有可用的订单。

blocks.en: Sell orders are items which people have listed for sale at a particular price,
blocks.zh: 卖单是有人以特定价格挂出出售的物品，

blocks.en: and buy orders indicate people looking to purchase an item at their asking price.
blocks.zh: 买单则表示有人想以自己的报价收购物品。

blocks.en: If you want to sell an item in your inventory,
blocks.zh: 如果你想卖掉仓库里的某件物品，

blocks.en: you can right click it and choose 'View Market Details'
blocks.zh: 可以右键点击它，选择「查看市场详情（View Market Details）」，

blocks.en: to see current orders for that item in your region.
blocks.zh: 查看你所在星域中该物品的现有订单。

blocks.en: After reviewing these orders, you can decide to sell it to one of the buy orders,
blocks.zh: 看过这些订单后，你可以决定直接卖给某个买单，

blocks.en: or to list it as a sell order.
blocks.zh: 还是挂出卖单。

blocks.en: Listing an item with a sell order can often make you a bit more profit,
blocks.zh: 挂卖单通常能多赚一点，

blocks.en: however, you need to wait until another player fulfills your order,
blocks.zh: 但你得等其他玩家来成交，

blocks.en: which can take quite a bit of time
blocks.zh: 这可能要花上不少时间，

blocks.en: depending on price, location, volume and other such factors.
blocks.zh: 取决于价格、地点、数量等因素。

blocks.en: If you'd like to improve your chances of your sell order being fulfilled,
blocks.zh: 如果你想提高卖单成交的几率，

blocks.en: its generally recommended to make your sell orders at a trade hub,
blocks.zh: 一般建议在贸易中心挂单，

blocks.en: and with a competitive price.
blocks.zh: 并给出有竞争力的价格。

blocks.en: Once you've decided,
blocks.zh: 决定好之后，

blocks.en: just right click the item in your inventory and choose 'Sell This Item'.
blocks.zh: 右键点击仓库中的物品，选择「出售该物品（Sell This Item）」。

blocks.en: If you're happy to sell to the highest available buy order,
blocks.zh: 如果你愿意直接卖给出价最高的买单，

blocks.en: you need only leave the duration set to 'Immediate' on the sell window
blocks.zh: 只需在出售窗口中把期限保持为「立即（Immediate）」，

blocks.en: and click 'Sell'.
blocks.zh: 然后点击「出售（Sell）」。

blocks.en: If you'd instead like to list the item as a sell order,
blocks.zh: 如果你想挂卖单，

blocks.en: change the duration from 'Immediate' up to 3 months
blocks.zh: 就把期限从「立即」改为最长 3 个月之间的某个时长，

blocks.en: and set the price you'd like to sell your item for.
blocks.zh: 并设定你想要的售价。

blocks.en: Take note of the taxes required to create the listing,
blocks.zh: 注意挂单所需的税费，

blocks.en: and of the number of remaining orders you can create,
blocks.zh: 以及你还能创建的剩余订单数量，

blocks.en: which can be seen in the lower left hand side of the window.
blocks.zh: 这些都显示在窗口左下角。

blocks.en: If everything looks good, click 'Sell' to create your listing.
blocks.zh: 确认无误后，点击「出售」挂单。

blocks.en: If you're looking to buy an item,
blocks.zh: 如果你想买东西，

blocks.en: you can buy it immediately from one of the sell orders,
blocks.zh: 可以直接从某个卖单立即购买：

blocks.en: just right click the order, choose 'Buy this' and hit buy.
blocks.zh: 右键点击该订单，选择「购买（Buy This）」，然后点击购买。

blocks.en: However, if you don't need the item right away
blocks.zh: 不过，如果你并不急着用这件物品，

blocks.en: and would like to try and get a better deal,
blocks.zh: 想争取更划算的价格，

blocks.en: you can instead create a buy order.
blocks.zh: 也可以创建买单。

blocks.en: From the market details view, click 'Place Buy Order' at the bottom of the window.
blocks.zh: 在市场详情视图中，点击窗口底部的「挂买单（Place Buy Order）」。

blocks.en: This will bring up the purchase screen where you can set your price,
blocks.zh: 这会打开购买界面，你可以设定价格、

blocks.en: how many of the item you are looking to buy
blocks.zh: 想购买的数量，

blocks.en: and how long you would like your order to last, up to 3 months.
blocks.zh: 以及订单持续时间，最长 3 个月。

blocks.en: You can even change the range to allow you to buy items further away,
blocks.zh: 你甚至可以扩大范围，收购更远处的物品，

blocks.en: but be warned that you'll need to travel around to pick them up individually
blocks.zh: 但要注意，如果是在其他空间站卖给你的，

blocks.en: if they are sold to you from another station.
blocks.zh: 你得一个个跑过去提货。

blocks.en: There is often a gap in price between buy and sell orders,
blocks.zh: 买单和卖单之间往往存在价差，

blocks.en: and the savvy trader can use this to turn a profit,
blocks.zh: 精明的交易者可以借此获利：

blocks.en: simply by buying low and selling high,
blocks.zh: 只需低买高卖，

blocks.en: using the difference between buy and sell orders.
blocks.zh: 赚取买卖单之间的差价。

blocks.en: Market trading in this way can be profitable,
blocks.zh: 这种市场交易可以盈利，

blocks.en: but watch your taxes and brokers fees,
blocks.zh: 但要留意税费和中介费，

blocks.en: as updating your orders too often can eat into your profit margins.
blocks.zh: 因为频繁修改订单会蚕食你的利润。

blocks.en: Now that you understand how buy and sell orders work on the EVE market,
blocks.zh: 现在你已经了解了 EVE 市场上买单和卖单的运作方式，

blocks.en: you're ready to start making trades,
blocks.zh: 可以开始做交易了，

blocks.en: capitalize on great deals and start turning a meaningful profit.
blocks.zh: 抓住好机会，赚取可观的利润。

blocks.en: Whatever it is you do in EVE,
blocks.zh: 无论你在 EVE 中做什么，

blocks.en: understanding how to use the market to your advantage will serve you well.
blocks.zh: 懂得如何利用市场为自己谋利都会让你受益匪浅。
